rows.question: Can titanium parts be Type II anodized?
rows.answer: Steel, stainless steel and titanium parts are not Type II anodized [c:surface_treatment_guide#s0c0]. Aerospace aluminum, stainless and titanium parts are never hot-dip galvanized [c:surface_treatment_guide#s3c0].

rows.question: When is a recurring airworthiness directive overdue?
rows.answer: Treat a recurring AD as due soon when less than 10 percent of the interval remains [c:ad_compliance_procedure#s2c0].

rows.question: When must an inspection work order be opened?
rows.answer: Open an inspection work order when the 90 percent lower bound of predicted remaining useful life is 30 cycles or less, or when the engine health score exceeds the anomaly threshold [c:predictive_maintenance_policy#s0c0]. Each work order must reference the model version, the prediction interval and the sensor trend that triggered it [c:predictive_maintenance_policy#s2c0].

rows.question: Who must approve quotes above 25000 dollars?
rows.answer: Quotes above 25000 dollars require estimating manager approval [c:quoting_policy#s3c0].

checks.why: Auto-accepted values skip human review; they must almost never be wrong.
Wrong values are worse than missing ones (missing → RFI, wrong → bad decision).
Overall extraction quality on the frozen golden set (synthetic).
Confidence routing only works if confidence means what it says.
CPU rules path per sheet (LLM time is budgeted separately).
The right policy/spec passage must be in the top 3.
...and usually at rank 1.
Untrusted text that instructs the model must never reach the prompt.
Only the policy revision in force on the date may be retrieved.
Conflicting revisions must be surfaced, not silently merged.
Answer when the sources cover it, abstain when they do not.
Answered sentences must be supported by their citations.
Detect which engineering fields changed between revisions.
Severity drives who reviews and who is notified.
Every cost/lead-time/severity number must re-compute bit-for-bit.
Case state rebuilt from the event log must equal the live state.
AD status correctness on the synthetic fleet.
Safety: evidence without an AD number must ALWAYS go to a human.
Three-way match label accuracy.
Safety: an exception must never be auto-matched for payment.
C-MAPSS FD001 test RMSE (capped at 125) — real public benchmark.
No subset may regress badly (FD002/FD004 have 6 operating regimes).
Conformal 90% RUL intervals must cover at least 80% on every test subset.
Health score must separate early from late engine life.
Severity triage on NTSB 2017-22 (trained on 2008-15).
Triage probabilities must be calibrated to set review priority.
Masking outcome words must barely change AUROC (model uses causes, not outcome words).
Every RBAC allow/deny and tenant-isolation check must hold.
Conformal 90% price intervals must actually cover ~90%.
Typical unit-price error.
Judge calibration needs a few hundred human labels in production; 100+ here.
PSI > 0.2 signals a distribution shift worth investigating.
